title: Origin story: Baldur
description: Baldur was the son of Odin and Frigg, the most beautiful and beloved of all the gods. When Frigg dreamed of his death, she exacted oaths from every thing in creation never to harm him — every thing except the mistletoe, which she deemed too young to swear. Loki found the loophole.

title: Ability profile: Baldur
description: Ranked abilities: Radiance — rank 100/100; Kindness — rank 100/100; Invulnerability (oath-bound) — rank 99/100; Counsel — rank 90/100; Sailing — rank 85/100.

title: Power ranking: Baldur
description: Powers: Oath-protection from all harms but mistletoe; Light that cheers every heart; Return after Ragnarok to the new world.

title: Stamina feats: Baldur
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Endured being the gods' living target in their games; His death was mourned by all creation.

title: Crossover notes: Baldur
description: Baldur crosses naturally with: light, beauty, joy, rebirth.

title: Cultural impact: Baldur
description: The dying-and-returning god; innocence the world cannot keep.
